title: Imadi Technologies overview
content: Imadi Technologies builds AI agents, intelligent software, and automation systems for real-world businesses. Its stated focus is practical technology that reduces manual work, connects disconnected workflows, and helps businesses operate more efficiently.

title: Automation opportunities
content: Imadi highlights sales and CRM automation, operations workflow automation, customer-support AI agents and WhatsApp automation, document processing with OCR and extraction, e-commerce product synchronization and order workflows, and automated reporting and data integration.

title: Imadi delivery process
content: Imadi describes a documented four-stage approach: Understand, Identify, Build, Improve. The team starts from the real business problem rather than forcing a generic technology.

title: Maria Aziz expertise
content: Maria Aziz describes her work as AI-powered products, intelligent automation, conversational systems, machine learning and NLP, and scalable SaaS. Her process includes understanding the problem, researching, solution design, building, testing and measuring impact.

title: Burhanuddin Patanwala expertise
content: Burhanuddin describes work in AI automation, business solutions, application development, custom software, web development, SaaS, cloud applications and software testing. His portfolio includes Imadi ERP, ReNaz WhatsApp automation, and MAflow.

title: Imadi ERP
content: The portfolio describes Imadi ERP as a custom full-stack business management system for a UK logistics and fulfilment company, covering sales, invoices, VAT, purchasing, inventory, logistics, double-entry accounting, banking, reporting, role-based permissions and backups.

title: ReNaz WhatsApp automation
content: ReNaz is described as a WhatsApp-based waste and scrap collection platform in Pakistan. Customers request pickups through WhatsApp with waste type, quantity, location and time slot; the platform matches requests to verified collectors and provides an admin dashboard.
